summary: Laptop asks for the disk-encryption recovery key at start-up
description: User's laptop LT-4471 shows the encryption recovery screen after last night's firmware update. User cannot work.

updates.note: Identity verified with two security questions.
Recovery key not found in the device record. Asked Platform Engineering to check the key escrow.

summary: Outgoing email stuck in the outbox
description: Messages stay in the outbox since yesterday afternoon. Receiving works.

summary: Elevated VPN authentication failures on vpn-gateway-eu-01
description: Since 07:40 CET, users connecting through vpn-gateway-eu-01 see 'invalid credentials' or error 809 after a password change. vpn-gateway-eu-02 is healthy.

updates.note: Traffic shifted partly to vpn-gateway-eu-02. Firmware 7.4.2 (CHG-20931) contains the fix; CAB review pending.

summary: Wi-Fi drops every few minutes across APAC-SIN-01
description: Meeting rooms unusable; wired desks unaffected. Access-point controller shows repeated radio resets.

summary: ERP payment run aborted with PAY-17
description: Supplier payment run failed with PAY-17 (locked batch). Deadline 16:00 the same day.

updates.note: Batch lock released; payment run completed at 11:20.

summary: Storage cluster ST-US-01 controller B reports intermittent latency spikes
description: No user impact reported yet. Vendor recommends controller firmware upgrade (planned as CHG-20935).
Several users reported an email asking them to confirm payroll details via an external link. Sender domain blocked at 10:40.

updates.note: Sender domain blocked at the mail gateway. Checking whether anyone clicked.
